Pragya is a first-year PhD student in the Intelligent Earth CDT program at the University of Oxford.
She finished her Master's in Artificial Intelligence at Imperial College London and, prior to that, worked as a quantitative researcher at Goldman Sachs.

Her current focus in on AI for materials discovery, especially to tackle environmental challenges. 
She previously worked on geometric machine learning in fields like neurobiology, molecular chemistry, and theoretical physics.
